instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: The rollercoaster turned my ((stomach)) upside down.

atoms.b: I am ((twelfth)) in line to buy tickets.

atoms.b: We picked up a ((variety)) of paint samples.
atoms.finishSound: We picked up a variety of paint samples.

atoms.b: It was a ((sincere)) offer of help.
atoms.finishSound: It was a sincere offer of help.

atoms.b: My love for plants was very ((apparent)).
atoms.finishSound: My love for plants was very apparent.
